key_facts: This document is the provisional race classification for the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix, issued on 1 November 2026 after 71 laps.
Max Verstappen in the Oracle Red Bull Racing car finished first with a time of 2:20:28.772.
Lewis Hamilton in Scuderia Ferrari finished second, 0.799 seconds behind Verstappen.
Kimi Antonelli in the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team finished third, 4.006 seconds behind Verstappen.
Seventeen drivers completed the full 71 laps and are classified; five drivers did not finish the race.
Lewis Hamilton set the fastest lap at 1:19.268 on lap 50.
plain_explanation:
This is the provisional race classification for the 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix, held on 30 October to 1 November. The classification covers the 71-lap race, which was 305.354 km long.

Max Verstappen won the race, driving for Oracle Red Bull Racing. He finished in 2 hours, 20 minutes and 28.772 seconds. Lewis Hamilton finished second in the Scuderia Ferrari, just 0.799 seconds behind. Kimi Antonelli finished third in the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team car, a further 3.207 seconds back.

Seventeen drivers are classified as finishers, meaning they completed the race distance or enough laps to be counted. Five drivers did not finish: Arvid Lindblad stopped after 58 laps, Oliver Bearman after 47 laps, Valtteri Bottas after 42 laps, and both Lance Stroll and Fernando Alonso after only 5 laps.

Lewis Hamilton set the fastest lap during the race. His fastest lap time was 1:19.268, achieved on lap 50 of the race.
